def: Vercel's open-source TypeScript toolkit for AI applications and agents: a provider-agnostic core for text, structured output, tools and agents, UI hooks for chat interfaces, and adapters for external agent harnesses.
practice: The usual choice for streaming chat UIs in TypeScript; version 7 (June 2026) is ESM-only and needs Node.js 22 or later, so pin one major version across all ai and @ai-sdk packages.
